name: How long does a typical room addition project take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical room addition project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a room addition project depends on its complexity, size, and the permitting process. A small, straightforward addition might take 3-5 months, including design, permitting, and construction. Larger or more complex projects, such as a second-story addition, can extend to 6-12 months or more. Permitting in Bay Area cities can sometimes add unforeseen delays. We work to provide a detailed timeline upfront and keep you informed throughout every phase of the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines for room additions vary widely; small additions may take 3-5 months, while larger projects can be 6-12 months or longer, including design, permitting, and construction.
